references.text: Describes the Lord's glory as a consuming fire on top of the mountain, which the Israelites saw
The Lord declares himself to be a jealous God who punishes the fathers' sins upon the children
The Lord your God goes before you like a consuming fire to destroy the enemies
Repeats that the Lord your God is a jealous God and warns against provoking his wrath
Asks who can dwell beside a consuming fire and eternal flames
The Lord is a jealous and avenging God
Quotes directly that our God is a consuming fire
